# Tilemap2D

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Tilemap2D")`

A grid of tiles drawn from one tileset image, on the 2D plane. Use it to build a level by painting tiles. Tile 0 is empty, and tile `n` is the `n`-th tile of the tileset, counted along its rows from the top left.

When `Collides` is on, every tile that is not empty is solid. The tiles collide as one body with merged edges, so a character runs across a floor of tiles without catching on the seams.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Methods

### `Clear()`

Sets every cell to empty.

### `FillRect(x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number, tile: number)`

Sets every cell in the rectangle from (`x0`, `y0`) to (`x1`, `y1`), both corners included, to `tile`.

### `GetCell(x: number, y: number): number`

Returns the tile in cell (`x`, `y`), or 0 if the cell is empty.

### `SetCell(x: number, y: number, tile: number)`

Sets the tile in cell (`x`, `y`) to `tile`; 0 empties the cell. Cell coordinates are integers, and Y increases upward, as in the world.
